priority_targets: Japanese artillery/vehicle columns converging on Changsha
forward fighter fields and fuel parks
support of Chinese evacuation/rearguards when fresh target data exists
Changsha_Xiangtan_airfield_action: Aircraft and high-value maintenance/signals assets rotate south/west before ground capture. Runways, fuel points and selected workshops receive planned demolition. Japan captures geography, not an immediately functioning heavy-air base.
post_capture_forecast_guard: Limited fighter/recon staging can become plausible only after repair in the next window; medium/heavy sustained operation requires a later gate. Do not credit captured Changsha/Xiangtan airfields on 18 May as instant full-capacity bases.
net_assessment: 14AF/CACW helps preserve IX War Area and makes Japanese logistics pay a continuing vehicle/bridge/POL tax, but cannot prevent the operational isolation and evacuation of Changsha.
